## Page or file

Which document is this about?

- File path: `docs/…`
- (if relevant) Section / heading: `## …`
- (if external) URL:

## What's confusing or wrong?

A short description of the issue. Quote the exact text if it helps.

## Suggested improvement

What should it say instead? A draft sentence or paragraph is welcome — we'll polish it during review.

## Anything else?

- Have you seen the issue cause confusion in support / Slack / Discord?
- Is this blocking new users? First-time contributors?
- Related docs that may also need updating.
